issues.title: Doesn't handle the wallet being on Ethereum
issues.summary: With the wallet on the wrong network the flow broke (Step 7 (Establish Connection (enable trading / agent approval)): Could not find role=button name="Establish Connection" (tried button "Establish Connection", button ~"Establish Connection")) and the dApp neither asked to switch nor told the user.
issues.flowName: Connect wallet, accept terms and sign trading connection
stepsToReproduce: Start with the wallet on Ethereum instead of Arbitrum Sepolia.
issues.expected: Ask the wallet to switch to Arbitrum Sepolia or show a "wrong network" message.
issues.actual: Step 7 (Establish Connection (enable trading / agent approval)): Could not find role=button name="Establish Connection" (tried button "Establish Connection", button ~"Establish Connection")
